name: ui
comment: Visual component library. Sources are split so the metadata TU never reaches a shipped program, and the UI stack links only into modules that actually declare a form.
requires_hint: RmlUi and/or accesskit-c are not vendored yet — run tools/fetch-rmlui.sh and tools/fetch-accesskit.sh
windows_comment: A cross build (--os windows) reads these in place of pkg_config, link_args and requires. RmlUi is the same checkout built a second time with mingw-w64 (tools/build-rmlui-windows.sh); SDL2, SDL2_image and freetype come from the distribution's mingw packages and ship as DLLs beside the program. AccessKit has no Windows build here, so a11y_accesskit.cpp compiles to its stubs under _WIN32.
windows_requires_hint: RmlUi is not built for Windows yet — run tools/build-rmlui-windows.sh (after tools/fetch-rmlui.sh)
